about.title: About Me
about.summary: Full-stack engineer with 4+ years building scalable SaaS products with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node/NestJS. I'm currently building AI features for a Brand Protection platform serving Fortune 100 global brands, while pursuing a B.Eng. in AI Engineering. Open to 100% remote roles (USD) with companies worldwide.
